english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the winner of a game or contest.

examples.english: They have been the champion for three years in a row.
examples.jyutping: keoi5 lin4 zuk6 saam1 nin4 dou1 hai6 gun3 gwan1

english.note: Use 冠軍 for the champion or the championship title someone holds, not the contest itself.
Use 冠軍 for the championship status or title awarded to the winner of a sporting competition.

examples.english: I’m really happy to win this championship.
examples.traditional: 攞到呢個冠軍，我真係好開心。
